description: Deep Strike placement aimed inside the 9" enemy exclusion zone is HELD on the boundary instead of being rejected — the inverse of the movement phase's over-range drag clamp. Landing a drop at exactly 9" by hand is fiddly with a mouse and effectively impossible with a thumbstick, so the ghost now stops at the nearest legal point outside the bubble and drags a dashed tether back to the cursor. Drives a real Kommandos (32mm) Deep Strike arrival against the fixture's Telemon (100mm) at (600,250): its exclusion bubble radius is 9" + 1.969" + 0.630" = 11.598" = 463.9px. Part A pins the historical behaviour with the setting OFF (ghost follows the cursor in, reddens, click rejected). Part B turns it on: a deep aim shows the tether, an aim 0.6" inside the line parks the ghost at 9.05" edge-to-edge, and the click places the model there.

steps.script:
# Arrive by Deep Strike rather than Strategic Reserves, so the 6"-from-a-board-edge
# band is out of the picture and the 9" enemy stand-off is the only thing shaping
# where this unit may land.
GameState.state.units.U_KOMMANDOS_H.reserve_type = "deep_strike"
return str(GameState.state.units.U_KOMMANDOS_H.reserve_type)

var m = tree.current_scene
var list = m.movement_controller.unit_list
for i in range(list.item_count):
	if str(list.get_item_metadata(i)) == "U_KOMMANDOS_H":
		list.select(i)
		list.item_selected.emit(i)
		return true
return false

# Frame the Telemon, its 9" bubble and the stretch of boundary the ghost gets
# held on, so the captures actually show the behaviour rather than a postage
# stamp of the whole table.
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_zoom = 1.2
m.view_offset = Vector2(600.0 - 930.0 / 1.2, 480.0 - 540.0 / 1.2)
m.update_view_transform()
return snappedf(m.view_zoom, 0.01)

# Setting OFF: the ghost sits under the cursor, wherever that is.
var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
return dc.ghost_sprite.position.distance_to(dc._get_world_mouse_position()) < 3.0

# A deep aim: the ghost is held way out on the boundary and the tether points
# back at the cursor the player is actually holding.
var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
var g = dc.ghost_sprite
return g.clamp_origin_world != null and g.position.distance_to(g.clamp_origin_world) > 100.0

# The whole point: the held ghost sits ON the 9" line (plus the clamp's 0.05"
# of daylight), not at some arbitrary spot the push happened to reach.
var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
var ghost_pos = dc.ghost_sprite.position
var best = 1000.0
for enemy in GameState.get_enemy_model_positions(2):
	var d = ghost_pos.distance_to(Vector2(enemy.x, enemy.y)) / 40.0
	var edge = d - (32.0 / 2.0) / 25.4 - (float(enemy.base_mm) / 2.0) / 25.4
	if edge < best:
		best = edge
return snappedf(best, 0.01)

# ...and the model actually lands there: legal, and as close to the enemy as the
# rule allows.
var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
var placed = dc.temp_positions[0]
var best = 1000.0
for enemy in GameState.get_enemy_model_positions(2):
	var d = placed.distance_to(Vector2(enemy.x, enemy.y)) / 40.0
	var edge = d - (32.0 / 2.0) / 25.4 - (float(enemy.base_mm) / 2.0) / 25.4
	if edge < best:
		best = edge
return snappedf(best, 0.01)

# Part C — the PAD is always clamped, setting or no setting: a thumbstick cannot
# land on a 1-pixel boundary, which is half of what was reported. Turn the player
# preference OFF, make the pad the active device, and the gate must still be on.
# That gate is the ONLY pad-specific difference; the push itself is the same code
# the mouse parts above exercised.
var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
return InputDeviceManager.is_pad_active() and dc._placement_clamp_active() and not SettingsService.placement_clamp_to_exclusion

# The D-pad press above cycles the deploy formation while a placement is live
# (pad_reinforcement_formation_row covers that). Put it back to SINGLE so the
# pad drive below is placing one model, like the mouse parts did.
var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
dc.set_formation_mode("SINGLE")
return dc.formation_mode

# Remember where the cursor is BEFORE the stick moves it. The glide target below
# is deliberately somewhere else on the exclusion boundary, so the stick has to
# actually steer there — a glide that reports 'already_on_target' would prove
# nothing about the pad.
tree.current_scene.set_meta("ds_pad_cursor_before", tree.current_scene.deployment_controller._get_world_mouse_position())
return str(tree.current_scene.get_meta("ds_pad_cursor_before"))

var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
tree.current_scene.set_meta("ds_pad_count_before", dc.get_placed_count())
tree.current_scene.set_meta("ds_pad_index", dc.model_idx)
return dc.get_placed_count()

# A places exactly one more model — the pad's placing press, routed as a real
# click at the virtual cursor.
var m = tree.current_scene
return m.deployment_controller.get_placed_count() - int(m.get_meta("ds_pad_count_before"))

# ...and it landed on the boundary, not at the illegal point the stick was
# pointing at.
var m = tree.current_scene
var dc = m.deployment_controller
var placed = dc.temp_positions[int(m.get_meta("ds_pad_index"))]
var best = 1000.0
for enemy in GameState.get_enemy_model_positions(2):
	var edge = placed.distance_to(Vector2(enemy.x, enemy.y)) / 40.0 - (32.0 / 2.0) / 25.4 - (float(enemy.base_mm) / 2.0) / 25.4
	if edge < best:
		best = edge
m.set_meta("ds_pad_drop_probe", "pad_placed_at=%s edge=%.3f\" (stick was aiming at board 700,640 = 7.5\")" % [str(placed), best])
return snappedf(best, 0.01)

# Leave the setting at its shipped default so a later scenario in the same run
# is not affected.
SettingsService.set_placement_clamp_to_exclusion(true)
return SettingsService.placement_clamp_to_exclusion

steps.equals: Hold Deep Strike placement outside the 9" exclusion zone

steps.script:
# The checkbox drives the real setter, so a player turning it off turns the
# clamp off for the placement already in progress.
var sm = tree.current_scene._settings_menu
sm._placement_clamp_checkbox.button_pressed = false
sm._placement_clamp_checkbox.toggled.emit(false)
return SettingsService.placement_clamp_to_exclusion
